race.title: What race are you training for?
race.noRaceText: Without a race you get a base plan for the next 8 weeks: easy running with no target paces. You can add a race later in settings.

goal.title: What are you aiming for?
goal.goalTimeHint: E.g. a marathon goal of 3 hours 45 minutes
goal.ambitious: The goal is ambitious for your current fitness (predicted {{time}}).
goal.realistic: The goal is realistic for your current fitness (predicted {{time}}).
goal.noResult: Without a result you get a base plan: easy running until we find your form.

experience.title: Experience and current mileage
experience.volume: How many kilometres do you run per week?

schedule.title: When do you run?
schedule.runDaysHint: Tap a day to include or exclude it. The long run is colour-coded.
schedule.longRunNote: The long run anchors your week: the other days are arranged around it.
schedule.windowNote: For mornings we check the forecast for 06-09 h, for evenings 17-21 h.

details.title: Just a few more details
details.baseWarning: Without a goal or a result (or with less than 12 weeks to the race) you get a base plan: easy workouts only.

errors.raceDateFuture: Race date must be in the future
errors.goalTimeFormat: Enter the goal time as h:mm:ss (e.g. 3:45:00)
errors.recentTimeFormat: Enter the race time as mm:ss (e.g. 25:30)
errors.longRunDayMissing: The long run day must be one of the selected days.
errors.cityRequired: Pick a city from the search results
